booking.title: Simple workshop bookings
booking.summary: Help a small workshop manage requests and schedules without losing track of conversations.
booking.context: The workshop receives requests by phone and messaging apps. Staff struggle to see the overall workload.
booking.need: Bring bookings and the schedule into one clear interface.
booking.users: Workshop customers and the administrator who manages bookings.
booking.data: Example services, appointment lengths and working hours. All demo data is fictional.
booking.constraints: The interface must work on a phone. The first version covers booking and viewing the schedule.
booking.result: A prototype with service and time selection and an administrator’s schedule screen.
booking.success: Customers understand how to choose a service and time, while the administrator can see new bookings and occupied slots.
booking.contact: Example client. No real contact details are provided.
booking.interaction: Prototype discussions and weekly demonstrations are planned.

volunteers.title: Coordinating volunteers
volunteers.summary: Bring events, participant applications and organizer information into one place.
volunteers.context: Organizers coordinate several events through separate chats and spreadsheets.
volunteers.need: Make it easier to choose events and review volunteer applications.
volunteers.data: Fictional events, dates, descriptions and participant lists.
volunteers.constraints: The first version covers an event catalog and clear application statuses. No real personal data is required.
volunteers.result: An event catalog prototype with an event page and a coordinator’s application list.
volunteers.success: Volunteers can find events and understand participation requirements. Coordinators can see the participants.
volunteers.contact: Example client. No real contact details are provided.
volunteers.interaction: Scenario discussions, an interim review and a final demonstration.

reports.title: Sales reports that make sense
reports.summary: Turn scattered store data into a clear view of sales and key metrics.
reports.context: The store owner manually compares reports from different periods.
reports.need: Show key metrics and sales trends on one screen.
reports.data: An anonymized sample of sales, product categories and dates.
reports.constraints: Use demonstration data only. Metrics must have clear labels.
reports.result: A dashboard prototype with metrics, a trend chart and a period selector.
reports.success: Users can compare periods and understand which categories generate revenue.
reports.contact: Example client. No real contact details are provided.
reports.interaction: Agree on metrics and hold regular short interface reviews.
